description: A unit of work inside a project, moving through the enforced lifecycle with human review. Under Review → Accepted → Completed → Verified; Under Review → Rejected is terminal. Completed requires evidence; Verified requires independent verification.

assignee_id.description: Person id of the assignee; null while Proposed.

milestone_id.description: Milestone id this task belongs to; null when ungrouped. Must belong to the same project.

reviewer_id.description: Person id of the reviewer (set when the task enters Under Review; only this reviewer may decide).

status.description: Lifecycle status. Transitions are enforced in code.

supersedes_task_id.description: For rework tasks: the rejected task this one supersedes. Null otherwise.

title: Task
